newsitem.title: USA: Intl CableTel to issue debt, preferreds.
newsitem.headline: Intl CableTel to issue debt, preferreds.

text.p: International CableTel Inc said it will issue $300 million in 10-year senior notes and $100 million in preferred stock due 2009 in a concurrent 144A private placement offering.

CableTel said it will use the proceeds for construction and working capital requirements. The company is expanding its cable and telephone network which currently serves 700,000 homes in various parts of the U.K.
The senior notes are expected to carry a cash-pay current coupon, while the preferred stock is expected to offer either a cash-pay or pay-in-kind dividend, the company said.
Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette will be lead manager.
Dealers said International CableTel debt dropped 1-1/2 points on Monday following the announcement of the offering. The company's debt fell 1/4 point on Tuesday, meanwhile.

"I think the bonds slipped a little in price in response the additional amount of debt the company is taking on," said Alan Ginsberg, head of high-yield research and cable sector specialist at Smith Barney Inc.
"Clearly, market participants understand that this company is increasing its leverage," he added.
As of September 30, 1996, CableTel had $1.682 billion of debt outstanding, according to a company spokesman.
